performance.verdict: ROAS holding but GBP dark and 4 SOW gates overdue threaten next cycle.

findings.text: 4 SOW milestones overdue: Aug 14 live-cooking event, Aug 31 pre-launch gate, platform audit, and funnel test + UTM — none show a completed event.
ROAS fell 21.64% week-over-week; last 3 days (Sep 11–13) show only 3 purchases vs 8 in prior 3 days (Sep 8–10), confirming a 3-day output drop.
GBP actions hit 0 for Sep 12–13 after averaging ~25/day for 45 days; 57.82% weekly drop signals profile visibility or posting collapse, not ad fatigue.
IG reach dropped 17.8% week-over-week; last 3 days average 724 vs prior 3-day average of 649 — modest recovery, so the weekly delta is a lag, not a new collapse.

Spend steady (~$53/day avg) while purchases thin; revenue volatility is extreme (e.g. $1,727.93 on Aug 29 vs $0 on Aug 19) — likely small order-count base amplifying noise, not structural fatigue yet.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 4 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; funnel test + UTM gap directly degrades ROAS attribution reliability.
suggestions.monday_update: Four milestones passed their Aug 14–31 deadlines with no completed event on record: live-cooking video, pre-launch gate, platform ownership audit, and funnel test + UTM go-live. The missing UTM tracking is the most urgent — without it, Meta purchase attribution through Shopify remains unreliable, making the 21.64% ROAS drop (F2) harder to diagnose. Nacer to confirm or close each item by 2026-09-17. Success check: all four items show a completed or formally deferred status in Monday by EOD Sep 17.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP profile immediately — 2 consecutive zero-action days after a 57.82% weekly drop is a confirmed visibility failure.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions registered 0 on both Sep 12 and Sep 13, after a 45-day daily average of ~25 actions/day and a 57.82% week-over-week collapse. Check for a suspended profile, removed posts, or a missed posting schedule. Restore posting cadence and confirm the profile is active and indexing by 2026-09-16. Success check: GBP daily actions return to ≥15/day within 3 days of the fix.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta ROAS through Sep 17; if 3-day purchase average stays below 1.0/day, escalate to creative_refresh on top campaign.

Re-check on Sep 17: if the 3-day purchase average is still below 1.0/day, move to a creative_refresh on BWS - Sales - Muslims ($840.44 of 28-day spend). No budget changes this cycle.
